messages:
priya-support: Heads-up — BrightBank (tenant_bright_77) reports 429s on /v1/completions during their end-of-day invoice push (01:45-02:15 UTC). They say reconciliation fails when the job gets throttled.
sam-ops: Got it. Any request ids or a log line we can use to attribute? Is it a single model/route?
priya-support: Provided sample header X-Req-Id: bb_req_88a003. Log extract:
```
2026-03-22T01:50:12Z tenant=tenant_bright_77 route=invoice-batch model=redwood/pricey-xl tokens_in=3800 status=429 burst_quota_left=0
```
lena-eng: Sounds like burst window exhaustion. Do we have their quota config (burst per hour, concurrency)?
sam-ops: Checking policy: monthly allowance fine, burst_window=3600s, burst_tokens=600000. Their job does 60 concurrent requests with ~3.8k tokens each → ~820k tokens in parallel, exceeding burst.
sre-bot: alert: tenant_quota_burst_zero — tenant_bright_77 exceeded burst for 12m at 2026-03-22T01:51Z; AlertID=BQZ-2210 sev=high
priya-support: Customer shared their shell repro for the push, using parallel xargs -P 60 with ~4k token payloads.
sam-ops: Quick mitigation options: 1) temporary emergency increase of burst limit for tenant, 2) schedule a short rolling window for their job (staggered starts), 3) recommend client-side concurrency cap.
lena-eng: For observability, add these dashboards/panels: - 429 rate heatmap by tenant/route/model - burst_quota_left timeseries - per-tenant token consumption cumulative graph. Suggest PromQL snippets in Grafana.
ops-graphs: PromQL examples to link in dashboard:
```
sum by(tenant,route,model) (increase(redwood_api_responses_total{code="429"}[10m]))
sum by(tenant) (increase(redwood_tokens_consumed_total[1h]))
avg_over_time(redwood_quota_burst_remaining[30m])
```
priya-support: Customer accepted a temporary throttle on their API key to concurrency=8 while we investigate. Can we apply an emergency rule and monitor impact?
sam-ops: Applied key throttle policy and created change CHG-5872 to increase burst by 25% for 45m as a one-off. Monitoring shows 429s dropped immediately.
lena-eng: Postmortem actions I propose:
- Add tenant-level playbook: If burst_remaining hits 0 and 429 rate > 50/min for >5m => auto-notify support + suggest emergency burst bump + client guidance link
- Add quick tenant filters on tenant detail page prepopulating tenant label for the 429/burst panels
- Add docs: sample client patterns (chunk to <=1k tokens, concurrency <=10, exponential backoff with jitter)
ops-graphs: I'll add the dashboard panels and create an alert rule that pages on sustained burst_zero + 429 surge. Will link runbook.
billing-bot: FYI — reconciliation failures logged for tenant_bright_77 between 01:45-02:30 UTC; user impact high. Billing team requested a follow-up with customer to confirm no duplicate invoices.
priya-support: Shared mitigations with BrightBank and scheduled a sync at 09:00 UTC tomorrow. They've agreed to throttle and to split the job into multiple waves.
sam-ops: Reverted the emergency burst bump at 2026-03-22T03:00Z (CHG-5872 closed). We'll monitor for recurrence.
priya-support: Closing the support loop here; opened incident INC-2026-0322-burst with attached logs and dashboard links. Will update after the 09:00 sync. :white_check_mark:
